notes: Render: the lights are in the picture as bulbs round the model. Drag one and it follows the pointer round the model, like turning the camera; the wheel over it makes it bigger or smaller (softer or harder shadows), Alt+wheel stronger or weaker. L hides them; they are never in what you save
Render (F12 in Model and Pose, or the Render button): the model as a photo, with soft shadows, light from the whole sky and reflections of a studio
Materials named for filaments: matte, PLA, silk, PETG, metal, marble, wood, sparkle, glow in the dark, resin; print lines as the printer would leave them

Six lighting set-ups (studio, product, warm, daylight, dramatic, night), then every light your own: drag it on the light map, its strength, size, warmth or any colour, up to four; Alt+click the model to put a light's shine on that spot
Sky light and reflections on their own sliders; a studio backdrop in any colour, the Physics scene, or see-through with the shadow kept
Depth of field (click where it should be sharp), any lens; save a picture up to 4K, or a turntable video (WebM) or GIF

Model: seven more modifiers. Bevel rounds every sharp edge, Smooth evens bumps without shrinking, Displace roughens a surface with a pattern, Decimate keeps the shape with fewer triangles, Remesh rebuilds a broken or overlapping model as one closed solid, Weld joins loose points, Wireframe turns edges into printable struts
